source.note: MMR-17 accepted run 2248 (worlds mnbl_0000002a and mnbl_0000002b): NavalDLC.GameComponents.NavalPartyNavigationModel with NavalDLCMapDistanceModel. The invalid-terrain sets, region switch costs and embark threshold are identical in both worlds; the face-group ids are TaleWorlds.Core.TerrainType values (IL-verified table in navmesh-bin.md section 5).

portOffsetFromGate.note: gate and port cells of town_1 in the two fixture worlds

observed.playerEmbark: only at a town port: SetSailAtPosition, the call the town's leave-by-sea menu makes (6.7 and 4.6 units from where the player stood at the gate); the player does not embark by walking onto water
observed.aiEmbark: anywhere on the coast: the generated ruler embarked from its own landmass with no port and disembarked on a water-separated landmass without one
observed.disembark: any coast of the destination landmass, for the player and the AI (world 42: the player disembarked on the off-shore landmass, which has no port)
observed.transitionHours: 0-3 h with a valid anchor (NavalDLCPartyTransitionModel); 48 h without one per IL, not observed
observed.connectivity: faces connect through shared edges; a grid navmesh with two triangles per cell (split along the (x, y)-(x+1, y+1) diagonal, MMR-16) connects cells that share an edge, never cells that touch only at a corner
observed.islands: engine islands span land and sea faces (town gate, town port and the water-separated landmass are all island 2), so an island is a connected set of All-valid faces

open: Coastline clearance (how far from land a port point must lie for ships to dock) was not measured: the MMR-17 ports sat one cell offshore on CoastalSea. Compiled port cells share an edge with their land entrance and lie within the installed port-gate envelope; every one is a mandatory host check for MMR-38.

No bridge (17) or under-bridge (25) faces were authored or observed, and neither shipped campaign map authors Bridge 17 (navmesh-bin.md section 5), so bridge candidates are unproven engine features until MMR-38 realizes and checks them.
MMR-17 authored no OpenSea (19) or River (11) faces (its open-sea fixture point was CoastalSea 18); OpenSea faces were later exercised by the MMR-59 climate fixtures, River faces never.
Face-ability toggles renumber islands and strand cached parties (MMR-17 known gap); the compiler emits no runtime toggle.

installedPortGateEnvelope.note: Distance from gate_pos to port_pos (map units) over every War Sails town with a port on the installed campaign map; the largest is town_V8. The playability policy bounds a compiled port to whole cells covering this maximum.
